mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(AMOUNT), 0) FROM POINT_LOG WHERE MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} AND TYPE = 'SAVED' AND REASON IN ('CHALLENGE_REWARD', 'MARKET_SALES')

SELECT m.CODE, m.NAME, m.ID, m.RATING, m.POINT, DATE_FORMAT(m.CREATED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS createdAt, ( SELECT i.PATH FROM IMAGES i WHERE i.TARGET_CODE = m.CODE AND i.TYPE = 'profile' AND i.DELETE_YN = 0 ORDER BY i.ORDER_SEQ ASC, i.PATH ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS path FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT m WHERE m.CODE = #{memberCode} AND m.DELETE_YN = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ce.CHAL_CODE) FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce WHERE ce.MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} AND ce.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL

SELECT ranked.ranking FROM ( SELECT m.CODE AS memberCode, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COALESCE(completed.completedCount, 0) DESC ) AS ranking FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ce.MEM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.CHAL_CODE) AS completedCount FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce WHERE ce.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL GROUP BY ce.MEM_CODE ) completed ON completed.MEM_CODE = m.CODE WHERE m.DELETE_YN = 0 ) ranked WHERE ranked.memberCode = #{memberCode}

SELECT ce.CODE AS code, c.CODE AS chal_code, c.TITLE AS title, DATE_FORMAT(c.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(c.END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS end_date, c.PROGRESS_STATUS AS progress_status, ce.STATUS AS entry_status, DATE_FORMAT(ce.JOINED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS joined_at,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FEED f WHERE f.CHAL_CODE = c.CODE AND f.MEM_CODE = ce.MEM_CODE AND f.STATUS = 'active' AND f.DELETE_YN = 0 ) AS proof_count,
IF(ce.STATUS = 'COMPLETED', IFNULL(c.POINT_EARNED, 0), 0) AS point_earned FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce JOIN CHALLENGE c ON c.CODE = ce.CHAL_CODE
ORDER BY ce.JOINED_AT DESC, ce.CODE DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{perPage}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce JOIN CHALLENGE c ON c.CODE = ce.CHAL_CODE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(ce.STATUS = 'JOINED'), 0) AS joinedCount, IFNULL(SUM(ce.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL), 0) AS completedCount, IFNULL(SUM(IF(ce.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL, IFNULL(c.POINT_EARNED, 0), 0)), 0) AS totalPoint FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce JOIN CHALLENGE c ON c.CODE = ce.CHAL_CODE WHERE ce.MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} AND c.DELETE_YN = 0

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKET_PRODUCT p

SELECT p.code, p.title, p.price, p.deal_status AS dealStatus, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKET_PROD_PICK pick WHERE pick.prod_code = p.code AND pick.delete_yn = 0) AS countPick, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM cr WHERE cr.type = 'deal' AND cr.target_code = p.code AND (cr.requester_code = #{memberCode} OR cr.responder_code = #{memberCode})) AS countChatRoom FROM MARKET_PRODUCT p
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.code DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{perPage}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalProducts, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.deal_status = 'SOLD' THEN p.price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM cr WHERE cr.type = 'deal' AND cr.target_code = p.code AND (cr.requester_code = #{value} OR cr.responder_code = #{value}))), 0) AS totalChats FROM MARKET_PRODUCT p WHERE p.mem_code = #{value} AND p.delete_yn = 0

WHERE p.buyer_code = #{memberCode} AND p.delete_yn = 0 AND p.deal_status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'SOLD')
AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

FROM MARKET_PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN POINT_LOG payment ON payment.CODE = ( SELECT MAX(pl.CODE) FROM POINT_LOG pl WHERE pl.PROD_CODE = p.CODE AND pl.MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} AND pl.TYPE = 'USED' AND pl.REASON IN ('POINT_ESCROW', 'MARKET_PURCHASE') )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKET_PRODUCT p

SELECT p.code, p.title, COALESCE(payment.AMOUNT, p.price) AS price, p.deal_status AS dealStatus, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(payment.CREATED_AT, p.updated_at, p.created_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS purchasedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKET_PROD_PICK pick WHERE pick.prod_code = p.code AND pick.delete_yn = 0) AS countPick, (SELECT cr.room_id FROM CHAT_ROOM cr WHERE cr.type = 'deal' AND cr.target_code = p.code AND ((cr.requester_code = #{memberCode} AND cr.responder_code = p.mem_code) OR (cr.responder_code = #{memberCode} AND cr.requester_code = p.mem_code)) ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC, cr.code DESC LIMIT 1) AS roomId
ORDER BY COALESCE(payment.CREATED_AT, p.updated_at, p.created_at) DESC, p.code DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{perPage}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalProducts, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.deal_status = 'SOLD' THEN COALESCE(payment.AMOUNT, p.price) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKET_PRODUCT activity WHERE activity.delete_yn = 0 AND activity.deal_status = 'SOLD' AND (activity.mem_code = #{memberCode} OR activity.buyer_code = #{memberCode})) AS totalActivity

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.mem_code) AS totalAuthors, COUNT(*) AS totalLikes, COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.feed_code = f.code AND c.mem_code = #{value} AND c.status = 'active' AND c.delete_yn = 0)), 0) AS totalComments FROM FEED f WHERE f.status = 'active' AND f.delete_yn = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FEED_LIKE fl WHERE fl.feed_code = f.code AND fl.mem_code = #{value} AND fl.delete_yn = 0)

WITH recent_challenges AS ( SELECT c.CODE AS chal_code, c.TITLE AS title, c.START_DATE AS start_date, c.END_DATE AS end_date,
MAX(ce.JOINED_AT) AS joined_at, MAX(ce.CODE) AS entry_code,
CASE WHEN c.END_DATE > c.START_DATE THEN DATEDIFF( DATE(DATE_SUB(c.END_DATE, INTERVAL 1 SECOND)), DATE(c.START_DATE) ) + 1 ELSE 0 END AS goal_days
FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce JOIN CHALLENGE c ON c.CODE = ce.CHAL_CODE
WHERE ce.MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} AND ce.STATUS IN ('JOINED', 'COMPLETED') AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL AND c.DELETE_YN = 0
GROUP BY c.CODE, c.TITLE, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE
ORDER BY joined_at DESC, entry_code DESC, chal_code DESC LIMIT 5 ),
proof_stats AS ( SELECT rc.chal_code, COUNT(f.CODE) AS proof_count, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(f.CREATED_AT)) AS proof_days
FROM recent_challenges rc
LEFT JOIN FEED f ON f.CHAL_CODE = rc.chal_code AND f.MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} AND f.DELETE_YN = 0 AND f.STATUS = 'active' AND f.CREATED_AT >= rc.joined_at AND f.CREATED_AT >= rc.start_date AND f.CREATED_AT < rc.end_date AND f.CREATED_AT <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
GROUP BY rc.chal_code )
SELECT rc.chal_code, rc.title, ps.proof_count, ps.proof_days, rc.goal_days,
COALESCE( ROUND( LEAST( 100.0, 100.0 * ps.proof_days / NULLIF(rc.goal_days, 0) ), 1 ), 0 ) AS achievement_rate
FROM recent_challenges rc JOIN proof_stats ps ON ps.chal_code = rc.chal_code
ORDER BY rc.joined_at DESC, rc.entry_code DESC, rc.chal_code DESC

WITH point_scores AS ( SELECT pl.MEM_CODE,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN pl.REASON = 'CHALLENGE_REWARD' THEN pl.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) + FLOOR( COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN pl.REASON = 'MARKET_SALES' THEN pl.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) / 10 ) AS rating_score
FROM POINT_LOG pl
WHERE pl.TYPE = 'SAVED' AND pl.REASON IN ('CHALLENGE_REWARD', 'MARKET_SALES')
GROUP BY pl.MEM_CODE ),
completed_challenges AS ( SELECT ce.MEM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.CHAL_CODE) AS completed_count
FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce
WHERE ce.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL
GROUP BY ce.MEM_CODE ),
member_scores AS ( SELECT m.CODE AS code, m.NAME AS name, COALESCE(ps.rating_score, 0) AS rating_score, COALESCE(cc.completed_count, 0) AS completed_count
FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT m
LEFT JOIN point_scores ps ON ps.MEM_CODE = m.CODE
LEFT JOIN completed_challenges cc ON cc.MEM_CODE = m.CODE
WHERE m.DELETE_YN = 0 ),
ranked_members AS ( SELECT ms.*, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY ms.rating_score DESC ) AS ranking
FROM member_scores ms )
